voice.text: Shere Khan the tiger is strong. [pause] Where did the energy in his muscles <emphasis>begin</emphasis>? Tap your guess.

Chains cross, and that makes a <emphasis>web</emphasis>. [pause] The deer feeds more than one hunter — the tiger AND the wolf pack. Each animal has its own job in the web: its niche.

And when anything dies, the cleanup crew — mushrooms and beetles, the <emphasis>decomposers</emphasis> — return every scrap to the soil. The loop closes. [pause] All the deer are a population. All the living things, a community. Add sun, rain and soil — an ecosystem.
